input_parameters.title: ReadAPageOfDealsRequest

after.title: After
after.description: Pagination token from previous response to fetch the subsequent page.
after.human_parameter_description: Use the token from the previous page of results to continue where you left off. Leave empty to start from the first page.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of deals to return per page (default: 10). Maximum is 100 normally, but when propertiesWithHistory is requested, the maximum is 50.
limit.human_parameter_description: How many deals to return per page. Maximum 100 normally, but limited to 50 when requesting properties with history.

archived.title: Archived
archived.description: Filter by archived status: true for archived deals, false for active deals.
archived.human_parameter_description: Whether to show archived deals. Set to true to list archived deals; leave false to see active deals.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: List of deal property names to include in the response.
properties.human_parameter_description: Which deal fields you want included in each result (e.g., dealname, amount). Choose only what you need to keep responses concise.

associations.title: Associations
associations.description: List of object types for which to retrieve associated IDs.
associations.human_parameter_description: Which related record types to include with each deal (e.g., contacts, companies). Adds their IDs so you can link deals to other objects.

propertiesWithHistory.title: Properties With History
propertiesWithHistory.description: List of property names for which to retrieve historical values.
propertiesWithHistory.human_parameter_description: The deal fields for which you also want the change history. Helpful for seeing how values have changed over time.

input_parameters.description: Request schema for retrieving a paginated list of deals.

Deal.title: Deal

url.title: Url
url.description: Direct URL to view the deal in HubSpot's web interface.

archived.title: Archived
archived.description: Indicates whether the deal is archived (deleted).

createdAt.title: Created At
createdAt.description: Timestamp when the deal was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedAt.title: Updated At
updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the deal was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

archivedAt.title: Archived At
archivedAt.description: Timestamp when the deal was archived, in ISO 8601 format. Only present if the deal is archived.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Key-value pairs containing deal property values. Common properties include dealname, dealstage, pipeline, amount, closedate, createdate, hs_lastmodifieddate, hs_object_id, and hubspot_owner_id, among others. Custom properties may also be included. Property values can be null when not set.

associations.title: Associations
associations.description: Object containing associated records grouped by association type (e.g., contacts, companies). Only included if the associations query parameter is specified in the request.

propertiesWithHistory.title: Properties With History
propertiesWithHistory.description: Object containing properties with their historical values and timestamps. Only included if the propertiesWithHistory query parameter is specified in the request.

Deal.description: Individual deal object with properties and metadata.

Paging.title: Paging

next.title: Next
next.description: Contains information for retrieving the next page of results.

Paging.description: Pagination information for navigating through multiple pages of results.

link.title: Link
link.description: Full URL for fetching the next page of results, including the after parameter.

after.description: Cursor value used to retrieve the next page of results. Pass this value as the 'after' query parameter in subsequent requests.

NextPage.description: Information for retrieving the next page of results.

paging.description: Pagination information for the associated records if there are more than can be returned in a single response.

Associations.description: Associated object IDs grouped by object type.

next.title: Next

id.title: Id

AssociationNextPage.description: Information for retrieving the next page of associated records.
